validation_scope: All 48 images decode at fixed dimensions; archived backgrounds and applicable old player-base canvases render through the actual backdrop compositor using explicit overrides. Old base dimensions and bottom/center anchors are checked without removing original transparent margins. Serialized data strings, actual animation graph names and autotile declarations are audited; no map event command is executed.
